question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I am not going to pay a _______ for this broken CD.
solution:
The correct answer is '**cent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**cent**" refers to a monetary unit equal to one-hundredth of a dollar.
 
• The sentence implies that the speaker is not willing to pay any amount of money for the broken CD.
 
• The other options: "**scent**" (a smell), "**sent**" (past tense of send), and "**send**" (to cause to go) do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I am not going to pay a cent__ for this broken CD.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Scent (गंध)**: refers to a distinctive smell, especially one that is pleasant.
 
• **Sent (भेजा गया)**: is the past tense of the verb "send."
 
• **Send (भेजना)**: means to cause something to go or be taken to a particular destination.
